milestone: Immutable CPU String literals and synchronous values

implementation.source: String literals, strict escapes, annotations, ordinary/inferred bindings, synchronous and imported helpers, conditional results
implementation.storage: Compiler globals copied into invocation-owned immutable UTF-8 buffers; canonical null/null/zero empty descriptor; nonempty allocation base/data identity, bounds, owner and UTF-8 checked before use
implementation.ownership: Existing record allocation ledger reused; ordinary helpers share backing within an invocation; raw CLI output retains result storage then settles invocation owners
implementation.limits: Whole-module CPU synchronous gate separates source Strings from existing private borrowed task diagnostics. Operations, worker/callback captures, fields, arrays, GPU and external decoding remain gated
implementation.optimization: Static literal reuse and earlier temporary reclamation deferred; no static provenance inferred from arbitrary null-owner pointers

coverage: Exact Unicode, NUL, BOM, combining sequence, emoji and scalar-width boundary bytes in raw CLI output
Strict escapes, overlong encodings, isolated/truncated continuation bytes, surrogates and out-of-range UTF-8
Typed/inferred String results, imported helpers, conditional selection and scalar/collection main cleanup
Private descriptors reject foreign/settled/faulted owners, base/data mismatches, negative/out-of-bounds lengths and malformed UTF-8
Retained String results outlive helper and invocation settlement; allocation failures do not publish results or leak owners
Runtime pre-cancellation, cooperative validation polling, asynchronous scan/copy cancellation and partial allocation settlement
Unsupported operations, compound values, captures, task/placement graphs and forged String IR rejected
Rejected literal builds preserve existing executable/MLIR/LLVM outputs
Frontend syntax/semantics/continuations, task diagnostics/recovery, file modules, Bool arrays, record arrays and Bool-array record fields regressions
qualification.scope: Focused qualification on Apple silicon; optimized applies to generated programs/harnesses. Existing Debug-configured core runtime archive is reused for debug/optimized, as in the existing suite. No GPU String claim.
qualification.preflight: An initial test fixture omitted the required .kalandra import extension; corrected before this final qualification. A build warning in a test range loop was also corrected. No production changes or rebuilds during final qualification.

native/lib/CheckedABI.cpp.change: Allow and rewrite the two checked String runtime calls; existing numerical call rules unchanged
